sources.title: Malzahar Build Guide: [S16] Rank 1 Malzahar Complete Guide | By Coach xblademojo

passive.name: Void Shift
passive.text: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.

spells.name: Call of the Void
spells.text: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.

spells.name: Void Swarm
spells.text: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.

spells.name: Malefic Visions
spells.text: Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions.If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.

spells.name: Nether Grasp
spells.text: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.

damage.value: Malzahar deals magic damage with Q and sustained damage with E’s damage over time.

archetype.value: Malzahar is a mage who deals spell damage and controls champions with silence and suppression.

axis.value: Malzahar can poke with Q and farm against threats.

winCondition.value: Malzahar clears waves with two spells later in the game, then rotates to apply pressure.

spikes.why: Malzahar gains Nether Grasp, giving him kill potential and chances to make picks.
Malzahar can cast Malefic Visions more often than at its 11-second cooldown.

mistakes.value: Malzahar misses a chance to refresh Malefic Visions when he does not use his other spells on its target.
